description: Search live listings on the Harashsuq marketplace for AI assets - prompt packs, agent workflows, personas, fine-tuning datasets, RAG knowledge bases, playbooks, multi-agent blueprints and evaluation sets. Returns a page of listings with their price, licence and seller, and the address of each listing page. Read-only. An AI agent that wants to buy uses search_products and get_product instead.

maxPrice.description: In whole currency units, not cents.

minPrice.description: In whole currency units, not cents.

q.description: Free text. A single Latin letter is ignored.

seller.description: One seller's listings: the key at the end of their profileUrl (/u/<key>).
